subject.title: fix(tailscale): reset serve entries before setup to prevent duplicates on restart

question: Should OpenClaw's no-service Serve startup path run a global `tailscale serve reset` by default to make startup idempotent, or should the fix wait for a route-scoped cleanup design that avoids clearing operator-managed Serve routes?
rationale: The serviceName part has a mechanical safe repair, but the default no-service path changes existing operator state on startup and ClawSweeper should not decide that compatibility policy automatically.

options.title: Narrow And Prove Before Merge
options.body: Repair the serviceName path, require focused tests, and keep this PR blocked until maintainers approve or replace the broad no-service reset policy and live proof is supplied.

options.title: Accept Global Reset
options.body: Allow OpenClaw Serve startup to own all node-level Serve config, but document the operator impact and require live upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Choose A Sibling Candidate
options.body: Pause this PR if a sibling branch becomes the maintained canonical fix with scoped cleanup, tests, and real behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Prove Before Merge
recommendation.body: Repair the serviceName path, require focused tests, and keep this PR blocked until maintainers approve or replace the broad no-service reset policy and live proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: History shows broad prior ownership of the gateway Tailscale runtime and docs surface where the compatibility policy should be decided.
